messages:
Maya (Procurement): FYI Nexa flagged a partial release on AWB 123-456-7893421 — 12 H100s shipped, customs released 6, other 6 held due to serial mismatch. Vendor proposing either air top-off (expedite) or EU pool RMA. Need quick call: accept split air (+$6.6k freight) or take vendor EU pool + RMA terms. cc @Anna @Jordan :thinking:

Anna (Logistics): Can we accept split? AMS depot can intake 6 tomorrow but customs need commercial invoice + HS code. If we go air for the rest ETA ~5 business days. Sea is 18–28 days. :clock3:

NexaSupply (Vendor): NexaSupply here — confirm AWB 123-456-7893421. Partial release due to 6 serials flagged DRL mismatch. Options: (A) Air top-off 5bd, freight $6,600 total; (B) EU pool replacement (10 units available) — requires PO amendment + RMA acceptance for returns. We can also provide 6 loaners for 30d (0.5% monthly fee). Uploaded manifest and serials to the portal.

Jordan (Ops): Cluster is already in p99 pressure for infer-prod; we have ~20 pending top-offs. If we lose those 6 we risk throttling capacity. EU pool sounds faster but we need firmware parity and serial lists immediately. How quickly can they be commissioned?

Liam (SRE): If EU pool units are firmware-different we need a 24–48h staging validation (burn-in + perf checks). Also require OEM SKU and BIOS/driver matrix. Loaners OK but must be tagged as temp assets and tracked in inventory.

Maya (Procurement): @NexaSupply can you push full serial list, OEM SKUs, and firmware revisions? Also update proforma for customs: HS 8471.50, unit value $25,000. If we go air we need a revised proforma showing expedite charge. If you can waive expedite subject to brokerage fee we'll consider that.

NexaSupply (Vendor): Uploading serials now. Proforma updated with expedite line item. Serial snippet attached:

```
SRL-H100-0003421
SRL-H100-0003422
SRL-H100-0003423
SRL-H100-0003424
SRL-H100-0003425
SRL-H100-0003426
```

We will waive the expedite charge if Redwood covers customs brokerage $450/consignment and signs the RMA acceptance (return window 14 days). We can also release EU pool replacements immediately upon PO amendment.

Anna (Logistics): Customs brokerage fee OK from ops budget. Need PO amendment authority from procurement/finance and confirmation of AMS dock slot for 6 units — tentative Thu 09:00 local.

Maya (Procurement): Starting PO amendment. @Aisha (Finance) please approve covering the $450 brokerage fee; procurement won't approve $6.6k freight without sign-off.

Aisha (Finance): We can approve the $450 brokerage fee and PO amendment for the RMA route. Not approving $6.6k expedite. Please ensure vendor signs RMA terms and provides serial manifest.

NexaSupply (Vendor): Understood — we will waive expedite if brokerage fee is covered and RMA signed. Sending updated RMA PDF to sign. Also attaching firmware matrix and OEM SKUs.

Jordan (Ops): Plan: accept EU pool replacements + loaners? If vendor wants RMA returns in 14 days, we need staging playbook. I'll prepare a staging checklist: burn-in 24h, perf checks, driver/fw sync. Will tag assets as temp-AMS-3421..3426.

Liam (SRE): Once serials received I'll schedule burn-in and perf runs — expect validation in ~48h after arrival. Will add firmware compatibility notes to the ticket.

shipment-bot: AWB 123-456-7893421 scanned at AMS hub — 6 units released, 6 held by customs (note: serials flagged).

Maya (Procurement): Closing loop — vendor to send signed RMA + final serial list by EOD, Anna to confirm AMS dock slot, Jordan/Liam to validate staging when units arrive. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
